༄༅/ /grol tig dgongs pa rang grol las/rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul 'don cha zur bkol bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// grol tig dgongs pa rang grol las/ rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul 'don cha zur bkol bzhugs so//

ྈྈྈྈ khro bo'i rgyal po dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ thog mar/ na mo: skye med don gyi bla ma sku gsum la: 'gag med rang rtsal ye nas rang gsal gdab: zhen med blo 'das rang rig lhun grub kyang: 'dzin med sku gsum rang chas skyabs su mchi: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la: yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid kyis: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: zhes skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas: rang gzhi lus su snying khar raṃ dmar ser la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor: de'i dbus su rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥdamar ser gcig tu gyur pa las: de'i 'od zer dmar pos rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khyab pas: rnam smin gyi lus bsregs nas 'od kyi phung po dmar po'i rnam pa can du gyur: de'i ngang la yun gcig mnyam par bzhag cing: slar yang: oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: chos thams cad ye nas de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam la: de'i ngang las gdan pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng na: rgyu'i yi ge rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥdamar po gcig tu gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las: kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin te: rang skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje'i be con nam mkha' la phyar zhing g.yon rdo rje'i tho ba me rab tu 'bar ba bsnams pas gdug pa can thams cad klad nas gzir bar byed pa: sbyor ging bsnol ba'i steng na zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs kyis bzhugs pa: zhal rngam zhing mche ba gtsigs pa: spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa: shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs pa: snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug sgra ldir ba: ljags nas bskal pa'i glog 'gyu ba: zhal nas hrīḥdang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrog pa: thod pa'i phreng ba sku la gsol zhing:

dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa: dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing: dbu'i gtsug tor na rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher ba: khams gsum dbang du sdud cing: srid gsum bran du bkol ba: bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs shing: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas khro chung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: gnod byed thams cad thal bar sreg cing sde brgyad thams cad bran du bkol bar bsam: thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥde'i mthar: oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐: oṃ h+ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: hūm̐ḥhūm̐ḥhūm̐: phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭa: ces bskyed rdzogs bzlas gsum gyi gding dang ldan pa'i ngang nas snang srid lha ma srin sde brgyad dang: bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus: tshar bcad nas 'dar yed yed bka' nyan gsung sdod par bsam mo: 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i gding ni: dbang chen rta mgrin ye shes kyi rol pa chen po gcig las nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i ngang las: gang la yang nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba med par gdon bgegs kyi steng du thog brdzis bya'o: de lta bu'i dgongs pa dang ldan tsa na: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: dregs pa can rnams las la bkol nas bran bzhin du las byed do: gal te bran du ma khol ba'am las byed du ma 'dod na: oṃ badz+ra thun bh+yo: badz+ra trig nan: badz+ra dzaḥdza: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: haṃ shaṃ tri trig nan: tri hur thuṃ dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: oṃ tu trig trig: tu trig trig: tri hur thuṃ dza: mā ra ya phaṭa: sarba bhū ta trig nan: zhes rtsa sngags la btags nas: rta bro brdungs pas bar chad gdon bgegs rdul du brlag par the tshom med do: dbang chen dregs pa kun 'dul las: mdun bskyed nye bar bsgrub pa ni: dmigs rten yod na bkram la: bdag bskyed dang ldan pa'i ngang nas: rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros:

dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: bdag bskyed ltar bskyed la: thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas: rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hrī: dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: thugs rgyud ngar dang bcas nas ni: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dag snang longs sku'i gzhal yas nas: sku dang ye shes bsam mi khyab: ma dag 'gro la brtser dgongs nas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐: oṃ h+ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐: sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs: dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis: gnyis med bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas: mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: 'dod chags dag pa sgeg mo dang: chags chen khrag gi rgya mtsho la: zhag dang tshil bu'i bcud ldan pas: lbu ba dmar ser tshom bus spras: 'khor ba gnas su dag pa'i rdzas: btung ba'i tshogs 'di bzhes su gsol: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi gtor ma 'di: ye nas rang byung chen po yi: sems can lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: bya byed gnyis med lhun gyis grub: rnam rtog 'khrul pa 'khor ba'i rdzas: zag med bde chen bdud rtsi'i mchog: rang shar rdzas kyi gtor tshogs ni: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam can bka' srung srung mar bcas: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: dgyes par mdzod cig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: tshims par mdzod cig bran g.yog rnams: zo zhig bza' ba'i tshogs la zo: thungs shig btung ba'i tshogs la thungs: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang: mthun rkyen yid bzhin dngos grub stsol: bdag mdun tha mi dad pa'i bsnyen pa gang 'grub byed/

mchan/ de nas gtor ma a mṛta dang*/ swa bhā ba 'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi khyad par can bde ba bskyed nus pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: gtor ma bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa 'di nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa 'khor dang bcas pa ljags hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis bzhes par bsam la: oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐: oṃ h+ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐: sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gti mug rdo rje mi rtog chos kyi sku: 'dod chags rdo rje bde stong longs spyod rdzogs: zhe sdang rdo rje gsal stong sprul pa yi: dbyer med rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: pad+ma dmar dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor na: skad cig nyid la rta mchog khros pa'i sku: shin tu dmar zhing rngam pa'i cha lugs can: kham nag ral pa'i khrod nas mngon mtho ba'i: spyi gtsug rta zhal ljang nag drag tu 'tsher: phyag g.yas be con g.yon pas tho ba bsnams: stag dang mi lpags glang chen chos gos la: skam rlon thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan: rus pa'i rgyan drug byug pa'i rdzas kyis spras: lto 'gro'i dbang po rnams kyis yan lag dkris: sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gdug can rnams: bzung nas brkyang bskum tshul gyi zhabs kyis mnan: sprul pa'i khro chung dpag med phyogs bcur 'phro: lha srin sde brgyad ma lus dbang du sdud: bskal pa'i me rlung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na: bde gshegs 'dus pa khro rgyal mthu rtsal can: pad+ma dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ba ni: byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: slob dpon pad+ma dbang gi lha: rnam sprul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs:

'dir byon tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol: me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: khro rgyal rta mgrin chen po'i sku: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sku skyod 'tshal: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol: dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas: dam can rgya mtsho sku skyod 'tshal: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol: gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi khā hi: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing: bar du rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyis dngos grub rdzas su rol par bya'o: de yang rnal 'byor pa rnams: rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i mchod pa phul bas: bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam la longs spyad par bya'o: de nas lhag ma bsdus la kha chus bran: lhag ma de 'dod yon gyi bdud rtsir bsam la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa badz+ra a ha ha te pra ti sang: zhes pas byin gyis brlab: oṃ sarba uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhi dh+ya bh+yi na ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas phul: phrin las bcol ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la: hūm̐: rnam dag chos dbyings zhi ba las: dbang chen khro bo'i sprul pa 'byung: thabs shes zla ba gsang thig las: g.yar dam can rnams 'du bar mdzod: mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug tshogs: ma mo 'byung po sha za yi dwags tshogs: dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: phud kyi bdag pos phud bzhes la:

lhag ma'i bdag pos lhag ma bzhes: kun kyang dgyes shing tshims par mdzod: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: 'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol: ces brjod la gtor ma bskyang ngo: gtor snod bshal la bdud rtsis bran cing brtan ma mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dgung sngon steng dang gangs ri g.ya' rtse dang: spang ljongs skyed mos tshal dang nags 'dabs dang: phyogs mtshams steng 'og gang na gnas pa yi: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: rang rang pho brang gnas nas 'dir byon la: phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod: ma ma sring 'gro ma pañtsa ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes brjod la bskyang: gtor gzhong ri rab bsam pa'i 'og tu dgra bgegs mnan par bsam: hūm̐: dbang chen dregs 'dul dkyil 'khor 'dir: bar chad dam sri 'dul ba'i lha: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: gtum chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing: dpal gyi rta skad tse re re: khro bo'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog: oṃ ma hā kro ta hūm̐: oṃ h+ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: hūm̐ḥhūm̐ḥhūm̐: phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭa: gnod par byed pa s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: rjes mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ shis brjod kyi bar yang dpal ri ba'i ngag bsgrig shes na legs la/ mi shes na bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa sogs 'di nyid kyi chos sde dang bstun pas chog go /maṅga laṃ// //
